base.motivation: Since you have a low heat tolerance (3/10) and will face a steep 19.6% climb early in the hike, you should wear the long-sleeved synthetic shirt (ID 5) to start. It offers high breathability and fast drying to manage sweat. Pack the short-sleeved synthetic shirt (ID 0) as a dry spare in your backpack.

items.name: Men's Hiking Synthetic SS T-Shirt MH500

middle.motivation: To prevent immediate overheating during the intense initial climbs, do not wear a fleece at the start. Instead, pack the lightweight, highly breathable micro-fleece (ID 13) in your backpack to use during rest stops or cooler flat sections.

insulation.motivation: With apparent temperatures dropping to 3.9°C at higher elevations, you need a warm layer for static moments. The synthetic padded jacket (ID 24) is ideal to pack because synthetic insulation retains its loft and warmth even in the high humidity (up to 82%) you will encounter.

shell.motivation: There is a 30% chance of precipitation at kilometer 2. Pack the ultra-light rain jacket (ID 21) because its extremely high breathability (RET < 6) will prevent sweat buildup during high-exertion climbs while protecting you from wind and dampness.

overall_strategy: Your low heat tolerance and the steep climbs in the first half of the route require a 'start cold' strategy. Wear only your highly breathable synthetic base layer (ID 5) at departure to prevent early sweating. Keep your lightweight fleece (ID 13), synthetic puffer (ID 24), and ultra-breathable shell (ID 21) in your backpack, ready to be deployed as you reach the cooler, wind-exposed higher sections or during descents.
